comment: Recorded exceptions for lint_kubejs_traps.js. An entry tolerates exactly `count` sites of one rule in one file (path below kubejs/). One more site flags the whole file+rule; no site left flags the entry itself. Every entry needs a reason; add `owed` when the exception is a known defect waiting for a decision rather than accepted code.

exceptions.reason: the event guard must load before every script of its type (each one calls icraft.guard while it loads); priority 1000 is what guarantees it, the 00_ name alone does not on a file system that lists by hash
the stock KubeJS example file, shipped as it came: priority 0 is the default and changes nothing
the liveness summary must load after every script of its type (it prints what they registered); priority -1000

the event guard must load before every script of its type (each one calls icraft.guard while it loads); priority 1000 is what guarantees it, the 00_ name alone does not on a file system that lists by hash

it must be the first EntityEvents.spawned handler of the pack (it flags the ISS casters every later spawn handler has to skip); priority 900 is what guarantees it, the 0_ name alone does not on a file system that lists by hash
a library: its login / logout handlers clear the cache before any consumer reads it; priority 890 keeps it in front of every script of priority 0, in its old place among the libraries

its own warnOnce stays: this library loads BEFORE the core (priority 890 against 880) and warns while it loads (the capability class), when global.icraft.core does not exist yet; a library never depends on one that loads after it. The last of the sixteen local copies, kept on purpose (2026-10-13)
a library: 17 scripts read global.icraft.core while they load; priority 880 keeps it in front of them on any file system, in its old place among the libraries
a library: its login / logout handlers clear the cache before any consumer reads it; priority 870, in its old place among the libraries
a library: five scripts read icraft.bosses / icraft.dims while they load; priority 860, in its old place among the libraries
not a library: priority 850 only keeps the place its 0_ name gave it (between the registry reader and the tick master), so that giving the libraries their priorities changed the place of no script
a library: 42 scripts register their 63 tick functions (global.registerServerTick / registerPlayerTick) while they load; priority 840, in its old place among the libraries

tick_fullMoonDetection reads level.dayTime (a method object, so the phase is NaN and the notice is never sent). Left dead on purpose on 2026-10-10, the comment above the function says why: the line would promise 'more numerous and aggressive' mobs that nothing implements
exceptions.owed: a design call: implement the full moon, or delete the function

exceptions.reason: these reads LOAD chunks on purpose: the one-time scan for the spawn village's tower at world setup (its own comment: 'also loads the 13x13 chunks that siting + place template need'). Not a timer, not a saved position; a recorded exception instead of a grandfathered count since 2026-10-13
